messages:
maria: quick sync — we need to lock the ranking/refinement API scope for the Q2 launch. customers pushing for predictable costs + stable scores.
kevin: timeline? we have two eng sprints left. need to decide defaults (top_k, truncation) so infra can size.
tess: from ML side, we should ship with score normalization = softmax over candidates, but allow "raw" scores opt-in. normalizing avoids customer confusion.
josh: customers (acme/paytown) asked for a deterministic tie-breaker. propose stable sort by candidate_id after score bucket.
maria: prioritize: must-have = stable scoring normalization, default top_k=10, truncation policy documented. nice-to-have = per-request quantization hints + per-candidate weights.
kevin: implementation note: default top_k=10 is cheap, but we need to support streaming scores if callers want partial rerank. streaming is M1.
lucy: infra concern: truncation semantics affect batch size estimation. we need clear contract: server truncates candidate list to top_n before scoring or after?
tess: important: scoring should be invariant to input padding. propose we do pre-filtering to N candidates then score, so client-visible top_k corresponds to returned list.
josh: agreed. also add header to response: X-Rerank-Process=(pre_filter|post_filter) so customers know pipeline.
maria: acceptance criteria for GA: 1) default behavior documented 2) sample SDKs (py, js) implement client-side top_k and show truncation examples 3) perf targets: p95 latency < 120ms for top_k=10 on dedicated.
kevin: rollout plan: canary to 5% traffic with automatic fallback to baseline model if score drift > 0.02 AUC on sampling evals. deploy-bot: canary started for ranking-refinement v0.9 -> 5% on prod-us, monitor: latency, score-drift, error-rate.
lucy: operational: add metric rerank.truncation.count and rerank.normalization.mode to dashboards.
tess: edge case: what if client sends 1000 candidates but top_k small — we should limit max_candidates_per_request to 200 and return 413 if exceeded.
maria: decision: enforce max_candidates=200 (configurable per customer), default_top_k=10, normalization=softmax by default with opt-out param `normalization=none`, truncation=pre-score filter.
josh: docs TODO: show request example: ```json
{
  "candidates": ["id1","id2",...],
  "top_k": 10,
  "normalization": "softmax"
}
```
kevin: follow-up engineering tickets: ENG-4821 (pre-filter pipeline), ENG-4822 (opt-out param), ENG-4823 (metrics & dashboards).
maria: i'll convert this thread into a short PRD and schedule a follow-up with sales to align customer config waivers. thanks all :thumbsup:
